tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: Please note that Microsoft Copilot is available to all King's students with your KCL Microsoft log in credentials.
Please also note you should exercise caution when using any tools that require additional log ins or account generation as these will likely collect personal data.

data.quote: You should not input personal data, sensitive information or content created by others into any AI platform.
